current_status: Pending root complete member/coverage diagnosis. Fresh reported negative geometry pool/gates do not establish the patterns below; no raw outcomes opened here.
all_rows_not_subset: Retain every member/seed and every permitted development row/label with factual class probabilities/logits, native served pool, truth for retrospective diagnosis only, masks/roles and class/source context. Also report all native correct rows where a gate can harm. Do not train on development truth, choose experts with it, or replace serving with oracle selection.
classification_partition: Native arithmetic pool wrong with at least one actually correct member: direct coverage-to-pooling opportunity; retain correct and incorrect signed margins, not only the count.
Pool correct while at least one member wrong: complete potential harm population.
All members wrong with a common strict rival: scalar convex same-query member pooling cannot beat that rival.

All members wrong without a common rival: this is not by itself a convex-pooling impossibility; multiclass mixtures may reorder competitors. Hidden fusion needs genuinely additional information, not an asserted oracle ceiling.
All members correct but native arithmetic probability pool wrong: impossible under strict consistent argmax/threshold arithmetic; any observed case requires tie/numerical/mask/serving-contract audit.
binary_or_multilabel_fact: For observed Bernoulli event y and threshold0.5, a_m=(2y−1)(p_m−0.5). Mean wrong with max_m a_m>0 is recoverable in principle by scalar simplex selection. If every a_m<0, no convex probability mixture crosses to the correct side. Apply separately to all labels and report repairs/harm for positive and negative events.
multiclass_fact: For every member m, if p_m(c)>p_m(y) for one common rival c, then every scalar simplex sum_m w_m p_m preserves that wrong inequality. This bound does not apply to class-specific scaling or learned hidden classifiers outside the member probability hull.
graph_specific_justification: Complete failures must contain useful correct member differences whose reliability varies with TRAIN-available graph/context and is learnable beyond scores-only/global weights; aggregate AUROC/NLL deficit or higher any-correct coverage alone is insufficient. No current positive evidence is asserted.
functional_boundary: Predictor-equivalent rotations/signs preserve complete logits and probability responses. Raw embedding/factor spread is not diagnostic. A hidden-state aggregator can use information discarded by member heads only if that information is genuinely label-predictive; no aggregation recovers evidence absent from every supplied state/context.
ranking_metric_limit: Any-correct threshold coverage does not establish AUROC rescue. AUROC requires complete positive/negative score ordering and actual NLL/calibration; arbitrary confidence sharpening is insufficient.
change_after_joint_training: A newly joint-trained aggregator changes member learning and selected states, so diagnosis of a frozen original bank is a plausibility condition, not proof that a future jointly trained model retains or converts the same errors.
